name: Log Inspector
description: Read-only English example for Plugin API 1.1: show the last lines of a log file you name, count a literal keyword, and keep everything bounded. No model, no server, no keys.
author: AITerminal community
instructions: Use when the user wants to look at a log file read-only: show its most recent lines and count a literal keyword. The path must be absolute and known to the tab's target (local or SSH); nothing is ever modified, restarted or sent to a model.

tools.title: Inspect a log file
tools.description: Read the last lines of an absolute log file path, count literal keyword occurrences and publish a read-only panel.
